content.text:
The section 2 "gap" is resolved — TERM appears as p0011 within the sec-1 paragraph run, so the full text is present. My investigation found:

- **No exclusive-dealing covenant anywhere.** The only "exclusive" hits are Contractor's IP ownership (p0020), a **non-**exclusive license *to us* (p0021), and an entire-agreement clause (p0051) — none restrict our sourcing.
- **No requirements, sole-supplier, minimum-volume, or non-procurement language**; searches for "requirements from", "sole/exclusive provider", "exclusively", "shall not procure/retain/engage", and "minimum" returned nothing relevant.
- **Section 1(a) affirmatively supports our freedom to buy elsewhere**: the engagement is "on a task by task basis" with work committed only via individually negotiated Statements of Work.

The preferred position for this rule is the *absence* of a customer-side exclusivity obligation, which the document satisfies. No redline is warranted.

input.quote: (a) Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services"), and Contractor agrees to furnish the Services on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Clear Capital, meeting the preferred position (not merely the fallback). Section 1(a) retains Contractor only "on a task by task basis," with scope and volume committed solely through individually negotiated Statements of Work, so we remain free to procure comparable consulting services from other suppliers; Section 2 (p0011) adds no minimum-commitment or exclusive-dealing term. Targeted searches for "exclusive," "sole/exclusive provider," "exclusively," requirements-contract language, and "shall not procure/retain/engage" surfaced no customer-side restrictive covenant. The three "exclusive" hits are unrelated and none restrict our sourcing: p0020 concerns Contractor's retained ownership of pre-existing property, p0021 grants us a royalty-free non-exclusive license (a benefit to us), and p0051 is a standard entire-agreement clause. The apparent numbering gap at Section 2 flagged in the planner hints is resolved: the TERM provision is present as p0011 within the Section 1 paragraph run, so no exclusivity text is missing from the reviewed text. No redline proposed.
